summary: Separate full Astra/max review: preserve stack and product direction, but correct mutation reconciliation, migration order, file cache freshness and run-specific evidence output before dependent execution. Coordinator transcription of returned independent findings.

open_findings.title: Freeze mutation outcome reconciliation before Stage 3
open_findings.impact: Receipt/status lookup and per-operation identity are missing. Snapshot idle/existence must not clear unknown.
open_findings.correction: Specify operation identity, authoritative outcome evidence, lookup and unknown release conditions, or explicitly preserve runtime-lifetime unknown and defer receipt reconciliation.

open_findings.title: Prepare boundary and styling migration before Stage 2
open_findings.impact: Current checker rejects Base UI and packages/ui stylesheets while the required checker change is scheduled later.
open_findings.correction: Add minimal approved import/CSS Module support with negative fixtures and temporary legacy CSS containment before first UI slice.

open_findings.title: Tie file cache freshness to real file changes
open_findings.impact: Tool edits or external deletion/recreation can leave stale previews after reopening.
open_findings.correction: Specify cache keys, forced refresh, mutation invalidation, external-change revalidation, stale display and regression cases before Query migration.

open_findings.title: Bind E2E evidence output to this run
open_findings.impact: Default scripts overwrite earlier run captures/evidence unless an ambient environment variable is set.
open_findings.correction: Use a cross-platform wrapper or explicit output-directory argument in exact commands. Register packages/ui checks before Stage 2.
